messages:
elaine (Sales): Hey team — AcmeCo POC needs a temporary throughput increase on hosted for a replay test. They want to run ~200 rps peak for a 6h window tomorrow. Can we get a scoped key or short-term quota bump?
carla (Solutions): Thanks — can you confirm org id, model, and whether they use streaming? Also is 200 rps sustained or bursty?
elain (Sales): Org: acme-enterprise. Model: redwood/fast-7b-q4 (quantized). Streaming: yes for partial responses, but most calls are non-streaming. 200 rps is peak (1h ramp, 4h steady ~120 rps, 1h ramp down).
carla (Solutions): Got it. We'll prefer a scoped API key limited to that model + IP allowlist. That avoids global quota changes.
raj (SRE): Scoped key + temporary quota is easiest operationally. I need token burn estimate to set the quota. Rough estimate?
elain (Sales): They said avg prompt+completion ~600 tokens. At 120 rps steady -> ~72k tokens/sec? wait math: oops. Edit: 600 tokens per request * 120 rps = 72k tokens/sec. Peak 200 rps -> 120k tokens/sec. They actually meant tokens per minute earlier — hold on. New numbers: 600 tokens per request, 120 rps -> 72k tokens/min, peak 200 rps -> 120k tokens/min. Use quota in tokens per minute for hosted.
raj (SRE): OK that's workable. We'll request a hosted exception with a token-per-minute cap. Security check first. @tom can you confirm retention & audit requirements for a scoped key?
tom (Security): Scoped key is fine if logs are retained per standard enterprise retention (90d) and we enforce IP allowlist + customer-submitted data handling agreement. Also need confirmation they won't request access logs export.
elain (Sales): Acme agreed to 90d retention, no logs export. They will provide IP CIDR blocks today.
carla (Solutions): For the request I'll add: model pin redwood/fast-7b-q4, time window 2026-03-25T14:00:00Z to 2026-03-25T20:00:00Z, scoped key with IP allowlist, token-per-minute cap 120000 for peak buffer, downgrade to 72000 for steady.
raj (SRE): I'll open the ops ticket and provision the scoped key. We need a simple test curl they can run — use this and confirm it works once key is issued:
```bash
curl -s "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <SCOPED_KEY>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood/fast-7b-q4","input":"Hello"}'
```
carla (Solutions): Perfect. I'll also add a note to pin to that model in the billing UI so cost spikes are visible.
infra-bot: Ops ticket created: OPS-4821. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/OPS-4821. Assigned to raj.
elain (Sales): Awesome, thanks. Can we get the key issued by EOD today so Acme can smoke test early?
raj (SRE): I'll aim to provision the scoped key and IP allowlist tonight. ETA 18:00 UTC.
tom (Security): Quick reminder: scoped key must not be shared with non-Acme accounts and will be rotated after the window.
elain (Sales): noted. Thx everyone :rocket:
carla (Solutions): :thumbsup: keeping this ticket updated with IPs and test results.
raj (SRE): Closing loop — ticket updated with token caps and time window. Will post key here once provisioned (and then delete the message and update ticket).
